$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. The deltas drop the duplicate per-block replay metadata a settled attempt stored inside its durable stream (the message source keeps the envelope the provider needs), and stop a tool call whose streamed arguments outgrow maxToolCallArgumentBytes or toolCallArgumentTimeoutMs (added tool-argument-limit.ts): the attempt is aborted, the cut call never runs and gets an error result; and, when maxOutputLimitContinuations is above 0 (default 0, max 2), continue a reply cut at the output-token limit with a short note instead of ending the turn (added output-limit-continuation.ts).
